geometry.axis: Y up; front screen normal points +Y,+Z
geometry.uv_origin: upper-left; U increases right, V increases downward
geometry.support_frame: dashboard body; approximate world-space Y=0 contact plane; no stability/contact qualification

changes: Retained dashboard body, ambient trim, instrument cluster and steering wheel geometry.
Removed all four original screen/map/routing overlay primitives and installed one clean rounded active plane with a separate satin bezel.
Removed mint emissive colors; set dashboard and wheel to dark neutral matte PBR, and cluster details to restrained analog colors.
Dropped source base-color maps only on body and steering wheel to avoid their mint stylization; retained source roughness/metallic and normal maps.
limitations: Generic host adaptation; no OEM identity or CarPlay integration claim.
Display proportions and placement are a bounded derivative of the source screen envelope; these are not a manufacturer dimensional specification.
Source preview and GLB geometry were reviewed, but no native renderer acceptance claim is made here.
The generated support plane is an inferred asset bound, not proof of physical stability.
